title: Chris Ramsay sees tic tac over Nellis
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Chris Ramsay sees tic tac over Nellis, about not stated at Nellis test range, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He was flying a commercial flight over Nellis testing range and he saw that that tic tac that I showed you guys.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Chris Ramsay was on a commercial flight over the Nellis test range, a large military testing area in Nevada, when he saw a "tic tac," a white oval object shaped like the mint, like the one in a famous Navy sighting. If true, it would mean such objects show up over military ranges and can be seen by ordinary passengers, not just fighter pilots.
